meta.ref_mid_basis: arithmetic mean of the three readable bank mids (BOC 6.67705, CMB 6.67747, HSBC 6.6745513); SAFE parity could not be read (F01)
meta.formula: total = amount x (selling rate / reference mid - 1) + clamp(0.1% x CNY amount, floor, cap) + cable / reference mid
